experiment: matched-history Ridge (one exposure) and locked-baseline residual correction
note: Descriptive. No promotion rule. 2Q26 is the legacy point. 1Q26 sales include ITR note-4 diesel subsidy R$ 672 million; 2Q26 includes diesel R$ 9.737 billion and a gasoline subsidy. Do not attribute residual differences to subsidies alone. Derived margin is 100 × GP hat / revenue hat; missing when revenue hat <= 0. Residual correction uses each target's locked financial-history baseline.

residual_correction.note: Residuals are actual minus the locked baseline forecast at each origin. Correction is OLS on earlier eligible pairs only. Fewer than eight pairs records insufficient_history and is not a fitted correction. Persistence remains a named dummy column; it is the control only when it is the locked baseline.
